newsitem.title: HAITI: Haitian Justice Ministry security chief shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Haitian Justice Ministry security chief shot dead.

text.p: The chief of security for the Haitian Justice Ministry was shot dead in the street by two gunmen on Monday, witnesses said.
Charles Avrinel was changing a tire at a gas station at a busy Port-au-Prince intersection when the two men approached on a motorcycle, the witnesses said.
"One man got off the back of the motorcycle, shot three times at Avrinel, climbed back on and they drove away," said a mechanic at the gas station.
A man from the nearby Justice Ministry came to the scene after hearing the shots and identified the dead man as Avrinel. Witnesses said Avrinel was shot in the eye.
The shooting followed several killings on Port-au-Prince streets over the weekend, including the slayings of two police officers.
